part2.question: Describe a person who is good at learning and speaking new languages

segments.v: I want to talk about my classmate Khoa. He is very good at learning languages. I met him in grade 10 because we sat next to each other in English class. He speaks English very well, like a foreigner. He also speaks Japanese and he is learning Korean. He learns languages by watching anime and copying the characters. He talks to himself in English every day. He chats with people from Japan and Korea on apps. He writes useful phrases in a notebook. He is not afraid of making mistakes. I admire him very much because he works hard and he is very brave. He inspired me to learn Japanese. I hope I can speak many languages like him.
